items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★5 Downloaded this app only 2 days ago and
items.summary: Downloaded this app only 2 days ago and it is honestly one of the most fun games iv'e played in a while! The animation and art is CLEAN 🤌🏾, voice acting is AMAZING, the story PULLS on my heart strings, and the sound track is truly BEAUTIFUL. To put the cherry on top it's one of my favorite strategy type games, card based (I did not look at all the provided imagaes before downloading so it was a pleasant surprise). Anyone who loves strategy games please give this a try, it is so fun!!!
